reviewed_persistence_contract.atomic_commit: Both files and staging directory are fsynced before rename; finalized is set immediately after rename, then parent directory is fsynced. Post-rename error propagates without competing terminal or overwrite; actual exit and final audit remain mandatory.
reviewed_persistence_contract.authoritative_location: completion/terminal.json only; completion/artifact-index.json appears in the same single directory rename.
reviewed_persistence_contract.finalization_grace: After scientific failure only, timer switches to a 30-second invalid-record-finalization cap. Scientific stop elapsed is retained, no scientific callbacks resume, and no 600/7200 acceptance limit is extended. Grace timeout preserves prefix and propagates nonzero failure; no restart follows.
reviewed_persistence_contract.no_restart: Exclusive deterministic run reservation rejects any existing identity. Completed or invalid-prefix runs are never resumed; subsequent write/terminal attempts after finalization fail.
reviewed_persistence_contract.ordinary_write_failure: Tracked attempted artifacts retain their exact regular-file bytes even if truncated or unparseable; invalid completion indexes those bytes as uncommitted. A success terminal with an uncommitted prefix is rejected.
reviewed_persistence_contract.staging_failure: Prior incomplete terminal staging directories remain indexed only as uncommitted evidence; absent children are not fabricated. Staged success is not authoritative. Only final completion directory supplies terminal status.

reviewed_temporal_contract.accepted_sources: Preflight requires exact 43 membership and hashes, all prior unit bindings, exact four stage acceptance pins, all 522 identity artifacts, and source-bound implementation audits. Final code/config/protocol bytes are rechecked before terminal publication.
reviewed_temporal_contract.annual_receipts: All 234 receipts are generated in ascending year/configured ordinary-series order using only earlier native-success raw case rows and authenticated first-origin cutoffs; exact prior counts, strict 12h/24h availability and original selection ancestry are inherited from accepted admission/replay units. No 2025 outcome becomes a case. Run/year/series/chunk envelope, pure digest and file SHA are checked; sealed annual index is reloaded for every origin.
reviewed_temporal_contract.case_preparation: One 7200-second clock begins before preflight. Fresh accepted admission, collector and persisted-case reload share one 600-second phase deadline. Both accepted aggregate digests must match before any fit; unique 68140 sources and 56430 cases are distinguished from repeat reconstruction calls.
reviewed_temporal_contract.failure_records: Exact native reasons are authenticated across all 20 mapped variants and six raw references. Inherited E2 fallback uses matching mapped N0 scalar/source, or N0 full for offense/defense removals; independence derives from mapped full/fallback. New numerical/provenance failure invalidates. Current pinned parent is native-zero; general inherited fallback is exercised synthetically.
reviewed_temporal_contract.inference: Runtime checks and source-bound leakage/falsification reviews produce four explicit audit flags linked to immutable admission/collection/annual pointers. The already accepted public evaluate separates 2013-2024 inference from exposed-2025 point checks while retaining all-issued failure rates. Post-terminal independent actual acceptance remains false.
reviewed_temporal_contract.original_population: _source_manifest authenticates the fixed admitted data/runtime and parent chain. validate_cohort and origin_bundle preserve exact original origins and targetGameIds; append_scored_origin verifies ordered mapped/raw populations and exact original native reasons. Public inference receives all 3407 games, with 3135 development and 272 exposed 2025 games.
reviewed_temporal_contract.outcome_boundary: Prediction receives strict nine-field pregame sources and four-field outcome-free target contexts. Entire 20-series origin publication is written, hash-checked and directory-fsynced before grader invocation. Grader reopens the exact complete publication and reconstructs original-source/annual-receipt/transform/product recipes before accessing current target observations.
reviewed_temporal_contract.pilot: All 2013 identity rows remain. Exactly the first two 2014 origins form the retained pilot, including receipt reads, publication, all-series grading and mass/numerical checks. Projection includes elapsed admission/case/fit costs and the unchanged factor-two allowance plus 600 seconds. Deadline/RSS/pilot failure cannot choose a smaller population or restart.
